operators.name: custom_clamp_max
semantics: Computes elementwise max(x, max_val) for each element in input x.
Broadcasting follows reference torch.max(x, max_value_tensor) where max_value_tensor is a full_like tensor with scalar max_val.
Output tensor has same shape and dtype as input x.
Preserves stride layout; internally may use contiguous access but output layout matches input.

operators.name: custom_prelu
semantics: Applies PReLU elementwise: output = x if x >= 0 else weight[c] * x, where c is the channel index.
Input x is 4D with shape [N,C,H,W]; weight has shape [C].
Channel dimension is axis=1. For each channel c, use weight[c].
Broadcasting matches reference nn.PReLU with num_parameters=C.
Output tensor has same shape and dtype as input x.
Creates a tensor of the same shape as x, filled with scalar self.max_value.
In custom implementation, this step is merged into custom_clamp_max; debug_forward yields a full_like tensor with max_value.
Elementwise max of input x and the full_like max_value_tensor.
Applies PReLU activation: for each channel c, y = x if x>=0 else weight[c]*x.
